project_type: pnpm monorepo: Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects (edge), React + Vite (web), TypeScript packages
build_system: pnpm workspaces + turbo. Build: 'pnpm build' (runs tsc in protocol, vite build in web, wrangler deploy in edge)
test_framework: NONE currently. Must set up: vitest for unit tests (protocol crypto), Playwright 1.64.0 for E2E
test_command: Must create: pnpm test (runs vitest + playwright)
verification_instructions: 1. Build protocol: cd packages/protocol && pnpm build. 2. Run unit tests: pnpm test (once vitest configured). 3. Run E2E: pnpm exec playwright test (once configured). 4. Manual: dev server at localhost:5173, create room, join from incognito window
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/protocol/dist/*.js and *.d.ts are build outputs (gitignored). No snapshot files.
environment_constraints: Cloudflare Workers runtime has no Node.js APIs. Use Web Crypto API only. Durable Objects support hibernation (acceptWebSocket with tags). WebSocket in browser, no ws library.
contribution_requirements: Per docs/BRIEF.md §3 (12 Laws): client-side secret gen (Law 3), universal encryption (Law 4), 2-peer cap (Law 5), host auth (Law 6), 12h expiry (Law 7), replay rejection (Law 8). Record every design decision as ADR in docs/adr/. Stop if credit card required (Law 2). Route is /r/:roomId not /room/:roomId.
key_patterns: ECDH P-256 for key exchange, AES-GCM-256 for encryption, HKDF-SHA-256 for key derivation, HMAC-SHA-256 for authentication. WebSocket relay pattern: Durable Object stores peers, relays encrypted envelopes only. RoomClient emits 'ready' after key exchange. Zustand for client state.
directory_structure: Root: docs/ (BRIEF.md, STATE.md, adr/), apps/edge/src/ (Worker + Durable Object), apps/web/src/ (React app: lib/, pages/, stores/), packages/ (protocol, sync-engine, subtitle-*, ui-tokens). Tests will be: packages/protocol/src/__tests__/, e2e/ (root)
